_about: Calibrated joints for the rubber-hose rig (2026-10-14), in the body art's pixels (top-left origin, 512 canvas, ground at 256,444). They override points.json. Shoulders: the arm's joint, centred under the top of each sleeve (sleeve top + 18 px, the sleeve tube's radius), measured from Astra's original art. Wrists: where the hands hang at rest, straight down from the shoulder, a touch outward (front/back views) or forward (side views). Left/right are his own.
